text_en: I am one who has seen affliction under the rod of God’s wrath;
text_cn: 在上主盛怒的鞭责下，我成了受尽痛苦的人；

text_en: he has driven and brought me into darkness without any light;
text_cn: 他引我走入黑暗，不见光明；

text_en: against me alone he turns his hand, again and again, all day long.
text_cn: 且终日再三再四，伸手与我为敌；

text_en: He has made my flesh and my skin waste away, and broken my bones;
text_cn: 他使我肌肤枯瘦，折断我的骨头；

text_en: he has besieged and enveloped me with bitterness and tribulation;
text_cn: 他在我四周筑起围墙，用毒草和痛苦环绕我，

text_en: he has made me sit in darkness like the dead of long ago.
text_cn: 让我居住在黑暗之中，好像久已死去的人。

text_en: He has walled me about so that I cannot escape; he has put heavy chains on me;
text_cn: 他用垣墙围困我，不能逃脱；并且加重我的桎（zhì）梏（gù）；

text_en: though I call and cry for help, he shuts out my prayer;
text_cn: 我呼吁求救时，他却掩耳不听我的祈祷。

text_en: he has blocked my ways with hewn stones, he has made my paths crooked.
text_cn: 他用方石堵住了我的去路，阻塞了我的行径。

text_en: He is a bear lying in wait for me, a lion in hiding;
text_cn: 上主之于我，像是一只潜伏的狗熊，是一头藏匿的狮子，

text_en: he led me off my way and tore me to pieces; he has made me desolate;
text_cn: 他把我拖到路旁，扑捉撕裂，加以摧残；

text_en: he bent his bow and set me as a mark for his arrow.
text_cn: 又拉开他的弓，瞄准我，把我当作众矢之的。

text_en: He shot into my vitals the arrows of his quiver;
text_cn: 他用箭囊的箭，射穿了我的双腰；

text_en: I have become the laughingstock of all my people, the object of their taunt-songs all day long.
text_cn: 使我成了万民的笑柄，终日受他们的嘲笑；

text_en: He has filled me with bitterness, he has sated me with wormwood.
text_cn: 他使我饱食苦菜，醉饮苦酒。

text_en: He has made my teeth grind on gravel, and made me cower in ashes;
text_cn: 他用砂砾（lì）破碎我的牙齿，用灰尘给我充饥。

text_en: my soul is bereft of peace; I have forgotten what happiness is;
text_cn: 他除去了我心中的平安，我已经忘记了一切幸福；

text_en: so I say, “Gone is my glory, and all that I had hoped for from the Lord . ”
text_cn: 于是我说：“我的光荣已经消逝，对上主的希望也已经幻灭。”

text_en: The thought of my affliction and my homelessness is wormwood and gall!
text_cn: 我回忆着我的困厄（è）和痛苦，尽是茹苦含辛！

text_en: My soul continually thinks of it and is bowed down within me.
text_cn: 我的心越回想，越觉沮丧。

text_en: But this I call to mind, and therefore I have hope:
text_cn: 但是我必要追念这事，以求获得希望：

text_en: The steadfast love of the Lord never ceases, his mercies never come to an end;
text_cn: 上主的慈爱，永无止境；他的仁慈，无穷无尽。

text_en: they are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
text_cn: 你的仁慈，朝朝常新；你的忠信，浩大无垠！

text_en: “The Lord is my portion, ” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in him. ”
text_cn: 我心中知道：上主是我的福分；因此，我必信赖他。

text_en: The Lord is good to those who wait for him, to the soul that seeks him.
text_cn: 上主对信赖他和寻求他的人，是慈善的。

text_en: It is good that one should wait quietly for the salvation of the Lord .
text_cn: 最好是静待上主的救援，

text_en: It is good for one to bear the yoke in youth,
text_cn: 人最好是自幼背负上主的重轭（è），

text_en: to sit alone in silence when the Lord has imposed it,
text_cn: 默然独坐，因为是上主加于他的轭（è）；

text_en: to put one’s mouth to the dust (there may yet be hope),
text_cn: 他该把自己的口贴近尘埃，这样或者还有希望；

text_en: to give one’s cheek to the smiter, and be filled with insults.
text_cn: 向打他的人，送上面颊（jiá），饱受凌辱。

text_en: For the Lord will not reject forever.
text_cn: 因为上主决不会永远把人遗弃；

text_en: Although he causes grief, he will have compassion according to the abundance of his steadfast love;
text_cn: 纵使惩罚，他必按照自己丰厚的慈爱，而加以怜悯。

text_en: for he does not willingly afflict or grieve anyone.
text_cn: 因为他苛待和惩罚世人，原不是出于他的心愿。

text_en: When all the prisoners of the land are crushed under foot,
text_cn: 将世上所有的俘虏，都践踏在脚下，

text_en: when human rights are perverted in the presence of the Most High,
text_cn: 在至上者前剥夺人的权利，

text_en: when one’s case is subverted —does the Lord not see it?
text_cn: 与人争讼时，欺压他人：难道上主看不见？

text_en: Who can command and have it done, if the Lord has not ordained it?
text_cn: 若非上主有命，谁能言出即成呢？

text_en: Is it not from the mouth of the Most High that good and bad come?
text_cn: 吉凶祸福，难道不是出自至上者之口？

text_en: Why should any who draw breath complain about the punishment of their sins?
text_cn: 人生在世，为自己的罪受罚，为什么还叫苦？

text_en: Let us test and examine our ways, and return to the Lord .
text_cn: 我们应检讨考察我们的行为，回头归向上主！

text_en: Let us lift up our hearts as well as our hands to God in heaven.
text_cn: 应向天上的大主，双手奉上我们的心！

text_en: We have transgressed and rebelled, and you have not forgiven.
text_cn: 正因为我们犯罪背命，你才没有宽恕。

text_en: You have wrapped yourself with anger and pursued us, killing without pity;
text_cn: 你藏在盛怒之中，追击我们，杀死我们，毫不留情。

text_en: you have wrapped yourself with a cloud so that no prayer can pass through.
text_cn: 你隐在浓云深处，哀祷不能上达。

text_en: You have made us filth and rubbish among the peoples.
text_cn: 你使我们在万民中，成了尘垢和废物。

text_en: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us;
text_cn: 我们所有的仇人，都向我们大张其口。

text_en: panic and pitfall have come upon us, devastation and destruction.
text_cn: 为我们只有恐怖和陷阱，破坏和灭亡。

text_en: My eyes flow with rivers of tears because of the destruction of my people.
text_cn: 为了我女儿──人民的灭亡，我的眼泪涌流如江河。

text_en: My eyes will flow without ceasing, without respite,
text_cn: 我的眼泪涌流不止，始终不停，

text_en: until the Lord from heaven looks down and sees.
text_cn: 直到上主从天垂顾怜视，

text_en: My eyes cause me grief at the fate of all the young women in my city.
text_cn: 因我城中的一切女儿，使我触目伤心。

text_en: Those who were my enemies without cause have hunted me like a bird;
text_cn: 我的仇人无故追捕我，像猎取飞鸟一样；

text_en: they flung me alive into a pit and hurled stones on me;
text_cn: 他们将我投入坑穴之中，把石块掷在我身上；

text_en: water closed over my head; I said, “I am lost. ”
text_cn: 水淹没了我的头顶，我想：“我要死了！”

text_en: I called on your name, O Lord , from the depths of the pit;
text_cn: 上主，我从坑穴深处，呼号你的圣名；

text_en: you heard my plea, “Do not close your ear to my cry for help, but give me relief! ”
text_cn: 你曾俯听过我的呼声，对我的哀祷，不要掩耳不闻。

text_en: You came near when I called on you; you said, “Do not fear! ”
text_cn: 在我呼号你的那一天，愿你走近而对我说：“不要害怕！”

text_en: You have taken up my cause, O Lord, you have redeemed my life.
text_cn: 上主，你辩护了我的案件，赎回我的性命。

text_en: You have seen the wrong done to me, O Lord ; judge my cause.
text_cn: 上主，你见我遭受冤屈，你替我伸了冤，

text_en: You have seen all their malice, all their plots against me.
text_cn: 你看见了他们对我的种种仇恨和阴谋。

text_en: You have heard their taunts, O Lord , all their plots against me.
text_cn: 上主，你听见了他们加于我的种种侮辱和阴谋，

text_en: The whispers and murmurs of my assailants are against me all day long.
text_cn: 你也听见了反对我者的诽谤，和他们终日对我的企图。

text_en: Whether they sit or rise—see, I am the object of their taunt-songs.
text_cn: 你看！他们或坐或立， 我始终是他们嘲笑的对象。

text_en: Pay them back for their deeds, O Lord , according to the work of their hands!
text_cn: 上主，求你按照他们双手的作为，报复他们；

text_en: Give them anguish of heart; your curse be on them!
text_cn: 求你使他们的心思顽固，并诅咒他们。

text_en: Pursue them in anger and destroy them from under the Lord ’s heavens.
text_cn: 上主，求你愤怒地追击他们，将他们由普天之下除掉。
